# applications

One application of a research field: what the player picks when the field completes. Weapons, buildings, armour and other items name the application that unlocks them.

A mod adds records in `records/applications/<file>.json` (`{ "$schema": "carina-records/1", "catalog": "applications", "records": [...] }`) and changes base records with patch rows on catalog `applications`. Schema: [applications records schema](../schemas/records/applications.schema.json).

## Fields

A mod record leaves out `id` and `prov`: the game assigns ids, and `prov` is the project's own provenance.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | `<namespace>.<snake_case>`: your package id with `-` read as `_`, then a name | yes |  |
| `field` | key of a record in `tech-fields`, or null | yes | the key of its tech field |
| `aiGroup` | integer 0..41 | yes | the AI research valuation group |
| `inStrategic` | true or false | yes | shown in the strategic (auto-resolve) combat summary |
| `nameKey` | text key | yes |  |
| `descKey` | text key | yes |  |
| `relayRangePc` | integer >= 1 or null | no |  |

References to other records are written as keys; the game turns them into ids.

## Also register it in

- the item it unlocks names it: `application` (weapons, buildings) or `app` (armor, shields, computers, drives, fuel-cells, specials)

## Computer players

Valued through `aiGroup` (one of the groups the AI's research valuation knows); pick the group of the closest base application.

## Limits

- At most four applications per field: the research screen shows four choices (`research-grid-capacity`).
- `aiGroup` is 0 to 41.
- An application has no effect of its own; its effect comes from what it unlocks, or from a colony-economy `sources` row.
- To suppress a base application, `remove` it: the compile lists every record and rule row still built on it (`removed-dependent`), which the mod removes or repoints in the same package.

## Patch paths

Rows on this catalog address a record by `key` and a field by `path`:

- `set`: `aiGroup`, `descKey`, `field`, `inStrategic`, `nameKey`, `relayRangePc`
- `append`, `insertAfter`, `removeValue`: none (no list fields)
